title: Firing Membership
source_quote: FIRING MEMBERSHIP Clay Space fires to bisque temperature in electric kilns, glaze firings in gas reduction kilns to cone 10 and offers two levels of Firing Membership: Basic and Production.
evidence_sentence: Firing Membership provides access to gas reduction kiln firings for potters with prior Clay Space student or member experience.
evidence_quote: Clay Space fires to bisque temperature in electric kilns, glaze firings in gas reduction kilns to cone 10 and offers two levels of Firing Membership: Basic and Production.
summary: Ongoing gas reduction firing membership for previous Clay Space students or members, available at Basic ($65/month) or Production ($95/month) levels with monthly studio task commitments.
cost_text: Basic $65 per month or Production $95 per month
how_to_join: Available to previous students or members of Clay Space
